options.title: Calibration profile
options.description: Presets gamma and saturation. Applies to both layers, or only the background when a VD-like center option is on.

options.title: Gamma
options.description: Used with the Custom profile. Higher darkens dark tones. Range: 0.50 to 2.50.

options.title: Saturation
options.description: Used with the Custom profile. Higher makes colors more intense. Range: 0.00 to 3.00.

options.title: VD-like center mode
options.description: A sharper center look (VD-style), keeping Valve's color correction and 8-bit output. Skips the profile above in the center; the center gamma below still applies. Turn off when Blue-noise dithering's center option is on.

options.title: Center gamma adjustment
options.description: Extra gamma for the center only. 1.00 = unchanged; higher darkens dark tones. Try 1.02 first for a slightly lighter center. The background keeps the profile above; this is a manual tweak, not a verified seam fix.
